title: Pointwise evaluation compatibility of native open tensor representatives
statement: For fixed data of native open tensor representatives, fixed n : ℕ, and fixed derived objects U and L, the evaluated system gamma composite equals the canonical finite gamma composite under the recorded evaluation, open-extension, tensor, and inverse-image maps.

proof.text: Identify the exact-derived adjunction with the right-derived adjunction transported to the exact right functor. Compare units on cochain representatives using the exact-functor factorization, then use localization faithfulness. Thus the native evalJ, which is the inverse of the mate of evalG, preserves the exact-derived units and counits.

Use the restriction/tensor evaluation square. Adjunction sends each inverse gamma to the tensor of its unit with the identity followed by inverse restriction. Tensor naturality, the restriction square, the unit equation and then the counit equation identify the two inverse projection composites. Cancel the invertible gammas to obtain the required forward component equation. This argument is the generic categorical projection square, independent of representatives.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0GL1 and 07A4; reduce the projection formula evaluation to restriction/tensor evaluation using adjunction mates. Generic categorical argument also used in Sheaf.SixFunctors.OpenTensorReductionSquare.projection_inverse_square.

theorem nativeOpenTensorGammaEvaluation_component {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (SX : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X)
    (SZ : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E Z)
    (O : SystemOpenModel l E j SX.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors
      SZ.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors)
    (On : ∀ n : ℕ, FiniteOpenModel l E j SX.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors
      SZ.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors n)
    (n : ℕ) (U : coefficientSequenceDerived.{u, u} l E X)
    (L : coefficientSequenceDerived.{u, u} l E Z) :
    (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation.{u, u} l E Z n).map
        ((systemGamma l E j SX.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors
          SZ.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors O).hom.app (U, L)) ≫
      (ProEtale.VaryingRing.evalJ (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
        (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) j n).hom.app
          (SX.systemClosed.tensor.obj (U,
            (ProEtale.VaryingRing.G (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
              (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) j).obj L)) ≫
      (ProEtale.StrictTower.moduleJ (compactSupportSystemLevel l E n) j).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((SX.evaluationTensor n).hom.app (U,
          (ProEtale.VaryingRing.G (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
            (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) j).obj L)) ≫
      (ProEtale.StrictTower.moduleJ (compactSupportSystemLevel l E n) j).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((SX.finiteClosed n).tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _)
          ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.evalG (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
            (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) j n).hom.app L))) =
    (SZ.evaluationTensor n).hom.app
        ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.J (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
          (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) j).obj U, L) ≫
      (SZ.finiteClosed n).tensor.map (Prod.mkHom
        ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.evalJ (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
          (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) j n).hom.app U) (𝟙 _)) ≫
      (finiteGamma l E j SX.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors
        SZ.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors n (On n)).hom.app
          ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation.{u, u} l E X n).obj U,
        (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation.{u, u} l E Z n).obj L)
